facts.text: Covered in an abundance of lush forests and dotted with small lakes, Takodana, located along the Great Gran Run, was a popular departure point that offered easy access to trade routes that connected the Inner and Outer Rim.

evidence.quote: Covered in an abundance of lush forests and dotted with small lakes, Takodana, located along the Great Gran Run, was a popular departure point that offered easy access to trade routes that connected the Inner and Outer Rim.

facts.text: The world was connected to the Ring of Kafrene mining colony by the Biox Detour hyperspace route.

evidence.quote: The world was connected to the Ring of Kafrene mining colony by the Biox Detour hyperspace route.

facts.text: Thousands of years prior to the conflict between the First Order and the Resistance, a battle between the Jedi and Sith occurred on the planet.

evidence.quote: Thousands of years prior to the conflict between the First Order and the Resistance, a battle between the Jedi and Sith occurred on the planet.

facts.text: The lower levels of the castle dated to the occupation of Takodana by the Jedi.

evidence.quote: The lower levels of the castle dated to the occupation of Takodana by the Jedi.

facts.text: Takodana fell under the control of Pirate Queen Maz Kanata via a plan that involved her conning the Geonosian Arkik Von out of Takodana, with the entire planet having been a score that Von was after.

evidence.quote: Takodana fell under the control of Pirate Queen Maz Kanata via a plan that involved her conning the Geonosian Arkik Von out of Takodana, with the entire planet having been a score that Von was after.

facts.text: During the High Republic Era, Takodana hosted a Jedi Temple that was manned by the Kyuzo Jedi Sav Malagán.

evidence.quote: During the High Republic Era, Takodana hosted a Jedi Temple that was manned by the Kyuzo Jedi Sav Malagán.

facts.text: The temple and surrounding area came under attack from members of the Nihil led by Krix Kamerat, who wished to destroy the temple.

evidence.quote: The temple and surrounding area came under attack from members of the Nihil led by Krix Kamerat, who wished to destroy the temple.

facts.text: A year after the execution of Order 66, Ahsoka Tano considered Takodana as a place to lie low after helping an attempted insurgency, during which she revealed herself as a Force-sensitive, on the moon Raada.

evidence.quote: A year after the execution of Order 66, Ahsoka Tano considered Takodana as a place to lie low after helping an attempted insurgency, during which she revealed herself as a Force-sensitive, on the moon Raada.

facts.text: Not long afterward, their presence was reported to the First Order by Bazine Netal and a battle ensued between the Order and the Resistance, who had earlier been alerted to the presence of BB-8 by the undercover droid GA-97.

evidence.quote: Not long afterward, their presence was reported to the First Order by Bazine Netal and a battle ensued between the Order and the Resistance, who had earlier been alerted to the presence of BB-8 by the undercover droid GA-97.

facts.text: Finn took up Luke Skywalker's old lightsaber and fought for a short time in the area surrounding Maz Kanata's castle.

facts.text: Abrams]] named the planet after Takadanobaba, a neighborhood in Shinjuku, Tokyo.

facts.text: Landscape shots of the planet were filmed in the Lake District, in the northwest of England, UK, in July 2014.

evidence.quote: Landscape shots of the planet were filmed in the Lake District, in the northwest of England, UK, in July 2014.

facts.text: "The landscape of Takodana" is a digitally modified view from over Watendlath Fell (54°31′12.74″N, 3°05′56.36″W) looking north across a digitally enlarged Derwent Water, which is shown as contiguous with Bassenthwaite Lake (which it was, briefly, in December 2015 after serious flooding).

evidence.quote: "The landscape of Takodana" is a digitally modified view from over Watendlath Fell (54°31′12.74″N, 3°05′56.36″W) looking north across a digitally enlarged Derwent Water, which is shown as contiguous with Bassenthwaite Lake (which it was, briefly, in December 2015 after serious flooding).

facts.text: The large mountain on the skyline to the right is recognizably Skiddaw, the fourth-highest summit in England.

evidence.quote: The large mountain on the skyline to the right is recognizably Skiddaw, the fourth-highest summit in England.

facts.text: "The Millennium Falcon arriving at Maz Kanata's castle" is a view southwest across the face of Walla Crag (54°35′14.06″N, 3°07′12.50″W), which overlooks the town of Keswick.
